newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Pricer to buy U.S. IT company Intactix.
newsitem.headline: Pricer to buy U.S. IT company Intactix.

text.p: Swedish price labelling company Pricer said on Monday it intends to buy U.S. information technology company Intactix International Inc. for 500 million crowns.
The companies have signed a letter of intent and owners of more than 80 percent of Intactix have accepted the offer, Pricer said in a statement.
"Thereby Pricer will become a leading supplier of systems, solutions and consulting services for retail chains all over the world," the company said.
The purchase will be financed through a directed issue of about two million shares in Pricer, equivalent to 11 percent of the company's shares.
Pricer's annual sales are expected to increase to about 300 million crowns in 1997 from 17 million crowns in 1996.
Intactix International is a leading supplier of software systems in space management and consultancy services for retail stores.
The U.S. company is expected to post a pretax profit of at least four million dollars in 1997, compared to 1.6 million dollars 1996.

"Through the addition of Intactix's profitable business and the fact that we will not have the costs of setting up our own operations in the U.S., Britain and several other countries, our chances of showing profit in 1998 increase further, said Erik Danielsson, president of Pricer.
